t: These are the garden railings to numbers 19 and 20 York Terrace East, and they're Grade I listed. The railings belong to the Regent's Park terraces designed by John Nash. He was a Georgian and Regency architect who shaped many important areas of London in the neoclassical and picturesque styles. His schemes were paid for by the Prince Regent and by the developer James Burton, and he often worked with Burton's son, Decimus Burton.
